findings.detail: The source schedule labels the Scorpion Holdings, LLC position as Asset Type Common, so blank index_classification should be COMMON_EQUITY.

rationale: C301 flags a missing or unknown index_classification. The raw source row is localized and explicitly shows Asset Type Common for Scorpion Holdings, LLC; the observed validator value is blank, so the extraction/classification output failed to carry the source-disclosed common-equity classification.
